name: lbook
description: Lbook - Trình Đọc & Nghe Sách Thông Minh
author: Lbook Team

scripts.build:all: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.electron:build: npm run build:all && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.json --publish never
scripts.pack:win: npm run build:all && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.json --publish never
scripts.pack:portable: npm run build:all && electron-builder --win portable --config electron-builder.json --publish never
scripts.pack:dir: npm run build:all && electron-builder --win --dir --config electron-builder.json --publish never
